normalization_for_transfer: Normalize corrected and original reference counts independently over EXACT shared panel genes; log1p(10000 * count / shared-panel total). Xenium is normalized over the same shared targets.
custom_targets: Custom splice/exon targets without exact symbol matches are retained as measured Xenium features, but excluded from reference transfer. No gene/isoform equivalence inferred.
